statement:
I'll look up the permit record for consignment CN-2207 first.
The permit record shows that no wildlife export permit is needed for this consignment of two live red kangaroos to Dubai, which is incorrect as Australia strictly requires export permits for native wildlife including kangaroos. I will hold this consignment.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the "no permit needed" entry "is incorrect as Australia strictly requires export permits for native wildlife including kangaroos" and holds the shipment.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
